evidence_rules.new_proposed_phrases: Every new phrase is editorial_target even when it resembles source wording. These are not newly observed owner queries.
evidence_rules.native_source_wording: Exact headings/prose of primary publishers. Displayed language and publisher region do not authenticate owner residence, author mother tongue, demand or efficacy.
evidence_rules.observed_query: Reserved for genuine query evidence with original limitations; no new first-party query data in this file.
evidence_rules.google_displayedfeature: Google PAA/related wording, not individual query logs or monthly volume. Researcher seed is not a returned query.
evidence_rules.retained_previous_classes: Original target_label_class values and IDs remain unchanged in retained_prior_targets; Google Trends returned related-query labels keep their original classification.
evidence_rules.metrics: All volume, KD, CPC, first-party clicks and impressions are null. Ahrefs Insufficient plan and Semrush no_api_units reported by root; no blocked paid probes retried.
evidence_rules.GEO: Clear source links, evidence limits, species/population and owner-task structure may help retrieval and assessment; AI citations, rankings and causal uplift are not established.

inputs.role: Six signed-out English product-feature sessions, 62 displayed PAA/related observations. Includes research seeds and excluded irrelevant/unsafe claims.
Exact current local product identities and copy state, not verification of claims or availability.

en.variants: Shared English edition first. US litter box/poop and GB litter tray/droppings can be used where natural, without automatic duplicate pages. No geographic qualification from researcher gl hints.
en.local_gate: Medicine authorization, product status, emergency services and spelling need country-specific checking; en-GB only for a genuinely region-specific page.

de.variants: German language does not make DE, AT and CH product law/services identical. Swiss ss versus ß requires editorial choice; UZH sources are explicitly Swiss context.
de.local_gate: No authorization transfer from a Swiss feed monograph to the EU or MSRA.

fr.variants: French-speaking markets are separate country contexts. FR complément alimentaire and Canadian-facing supplément alimentaire are observed lexical variants, not measured demand.
fr.local_gate: Regional product rules, medicine authorizations, availability and local clinic language need local checking; no automatic fr-CA clone.

it.variants: Publishing locale it corresponds to retained evidence alias it-IT; this does not silently commission a Swiss-specific edition.
it.local_gate: Legal feed classification and product claims require current local verification.

es.variants: Publishing locale es corresponds to retained es-ES evidence. Pienso (ES) versus alimento/croquetas (MX) are proposed regional choices; the Mexican manufacturer source establishes its wording, not relative frequency.
es.local_gate: No MX product registration, veterinary indication or price/availability transfers to ES/EU or MSRA.

nl.variants: Dutch sources establish displayed Dutch wording, not Belgian owner residence or demand. Dierenarts, kattenbak and keutels fit NL-facing drafts; Flemish native editing remains pending.
nl.local_gate: No automatic nl-BE clone or assumption of identical services, medicines or product status.

homepage_lab_and_manufacturing.basis: Founder original says no full animal-testing lab yet; current local homepage/shop claims an owned lab, lab testing, own manufacturing and GMP-certified production. Neither account was independently reconciled in this keyword task.
required_verification: Current versus planned or contracted capabilities
Applicable dated GMP certificate and legal entity
Actual finished-product test reports and methods
Market availability, fulfillment and lawful product claims by country
homepage_lab_and_manufacturing.metadata_action: Use research/evidence mission language pending verification; do not add tested in our own lab, clinically proven, own GMP facility or manufactured in-house to proposed metadata.

constraints: Exactly six products from products.yml; no dog product added.
Local preorder/next/dev labels describe source state, not verified commercial availability or regulatory authorization.
Probiotic strain/species findings are not transferable to every reptile or pet rabbit.
Rabbit ingredient studies do not establish live-culture hay-treat or calming-topper efficacy.
Poultry feather pecking is not parrot feather-destructive behavior; human/mammal findings are hypothesis-generating.
Do not add dose, treatment, cure, disease prevention, safe-for-all, instant calm, coat deadline, endorsement or best-product claims.
No urgent cat unblocking or rabbit diarrhoea/stasis query should land in a product-only response.
